purpose: Diagnose prompt sensitivity; exploratory experiment, not model selection on held-out data

variants.name: original
variants.context: Top-down three-lane road. The cream car at the bottom is YOU. Orange striped blocks form a barrier with one open lane. Find the opening from the image. No game coordinates are provided.

question.instructions: Which of the three road lanes has NO orange striped obstacle? Look at the row of orange blocks. Choose the gap, ignoring where the cream car is.

criteria.left: The LEFT lane is the gap in the orange barrier.
criteria.middle: The MIDDLE lane is the gap in the orange barrier.
criteria.right: The RIGHT lane is the gap in the orange barrier.

question.instructions: Where is the opening in the row of orange barriers?

variants.name: safe
variants.context: A top-down view of a three-lane driving game. Orange blocks are obstacles.

question.instructions: Which lane is safe to drive in?
